sealed_before: its runs: this file and L3b's reading (measure/l3.mjs local-b, ci-b, judge-b) are committed before either run
why: L3, as measured (receipts/l3.json), found every written file opened by every reader and 0 internal markers, but judged the PDF not equal in PyMuPDF, pypdf and poppler, and the CSV not equal in LibreOffice. Both are the instrument's, not the files'. L3 stays FAILED as measured. L3b is the fix, sealed before its own fresh runs.
